claims.claim: MMseqs2 is almost as sensitive as a full sequence search
claims.kill: MMseqs2's Fmax on Pfam domains is more than 0.05 below phmmer's on any of the 15 relatives
claims.scope: "its" in the quote is BLAST. This site does not run BLAST, so phmmer, a full sequence-to-sequence search, stands in for it. Pfam-A domain instances, raw calls, 998 human queries, MMseqs2 at sensitivity 7 (setting s7). Speed is not part of this test.

author_claim.quote: At 100 times its speed it achieves almost the same sensitivity.
